events.headline: The Clay Skills Marketplace Is Open
events.summary: Clay launched a marketplace of community-built GTM skills that are free to install and run in Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor; data used by skills consumes Clay credits.

events.headline: New and updated integrations in Clay
events.summary: Clay announced 24 new or updated data-marketplace integrations covering EMEA/APAC, public sector and real estate, buying signals, enrichment, dialers, CRMs, and warehouses; all were available on every plan and the free trial.

events.headline: Clay introduced an agent-first way to build GTM plays
events.summary: At Sculpt, Clay introduced an agent that plans, runs, and improves GTM plays using Knowledge Hub context; it was initially available to Sculpt attendees and was rolling out to early-access users.

events.headline: Clay Workflows launched in beta
events.summary: Clay announced Workflows, a visual canvas for complex GTM plays with branching, looping, code, and agent steps; it was in beta for all Clay users and planned to launch in the fall.

events.headline: Clay previewed an Inbound SDR Agent
events.summary: Clay previewed an agentic seller designed to qualify inbound leads through voice conversations and tailored product demos, with a pre-beta partner waitlist.
